newsitem.title: CHINA: China ICBC in loans to Yizheng.
newsitem.headline: China ICBC in loans to Yizheng.

text.p: The Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (ICBC) has signed an agreement to provide loans and working capital to three major companies in eastern Jiangsu province, the Financial Morning Post said on Thursday.

Under the agreement, the bank will provide a total of 1.59 billion yuan ($191 million) in working capital for Yizheng Chemical Fibre Co Ltd and the Chunlan Group, parent company of Chunlan Refrigerating Equipment Co, the newspaper said.
The bank's branch in Nanjing, provincial capital of Jiangsu, would also provide 900 million in loans to Yangzi Petrochemical Co this year, it said.
The branch had extended loans amounting to 2.55 billion yuan to the three enterprises at end-1996, the newspaper said.
